observations.classification: Current source ownership/semantic-number candidate, no accepted count or incident assigned.
observations.trace: The canonical ORDERED_SIGIL_COUNT is 5 and controls the enum ALL list and ordered puzzle/projection/submission arrays. The surrounding PuzzleSubmission and form-parser array signatures repeat literal 5 for the same ordered-sigil values. The current dimensions agree; conversion from one array to the other is compiler-coupled.
observations.future_direction: Central owner to assess exact prior finding aliases and whether array signatures should reuse the existing count owner while preserving five named form fields and exact behavior. Do not infer dynamic choice count support, silent data mismatch, runtime failure, or a new count from this observation alone.

observations.classification: Current bounded corroboration of one earlier ROOT-ADM-F008 source operation; no new unique count.
observations.trace: Exact and NotAt publicly carry a u8 position and derive Deserialize; text renders position + 1. A direct or decoded position 255 reaching text attempts overflowing u8 addition; result depends on overflow-check configuration. Public validated puzzle path rejects position >= ORDERED_SIGIL_COUNT, but projection/text APIs are separately callable.
observations.limits: The concrete first-party route, submitted/decoded malformed data, actual product exception, platform arithmetic behavior and all validate callers were not traced or executed. Historical q2697 fey_clue_text uses position 5 and array indexing, distinct operation even though admission authority is connected.

observations.classification: Bounded legitimate typed flow and conditional UI/error-owner question, no accepted unique defect.
observations.trace: Current template selects stable_id as option value and label as display; route parses into typed choices. WitnessPath Moon is submitted as Moon and displayed as Moon path. Both enum FromStr delegates to Serde and returns typed errors, which route maps to separate static message strings and submit discards in favor of HTTP 422.
observations.limits: No mismatch shown: hand-authored stable IDs currently match the visible variant names. What the client shows for an HTTP 422 and whether it must present a typed reason are not inspected. Keys and labels intentionally distinct; no normalization or legacy input is assumed. No product execution.

nonfindings: Every enum variant is valid as a single Sigil or WitnessPath; do not infer aggregate permutation validity or conflate Sigil::Moon with WitnessPath::Moon.
Stable keys and labels are different semantics even when some strings match; WitnessPath label Moon path must not be treated as a submission alias.
Source test assertions and examples are read only, not test results. Source equality is per-file, not overall snapshot or behavior proof.
Existing fixed choice count 5 and 3 are real authored cardinalities; do not introduce arbitrary nonzero/uniqueness rules to individual enum values.

lenses.assessment: Public clue text uses u8 position + 1; maximum value causes source-reasoned overflow contingent on unchecked direct use and compiler settings. Existing F008 applies.
